notes.title: How This Page Is Organized
items: The Dream-Eaters runs as two linked four-scenario campaigns played in alternating order instead of one continuous line.
This page keeps one shared overview and timeline, then splits the run into separate Dream-Quest and Web of Dreams track sections.
Each track should keep its own story notes, campaign log, chaos bag notes, scenario results, and deck upgrade history.

notes.title: Background
items: Friday, February 13th, 1925. Virgil Gray's impossible dream account in Tales from Nevermore spreads through Arkham and triggers a wider outbreak of shared dreams.

Letters pour into the paper from readers who claim they experienced the very same impossible dream, turning Virgil's story from a curiosity into a citywide phenomenon that even the Arkham Advertiser cannot ignore.
Doctors, academics, and skeptics dismiss the event as shared hysteria, but the investigators remain unconvinced and decide to test whether the Dreamlands are real rather than merely symbolic.

notes.title: Dream-Quest Setup
items: Virgil Gray and many of the affected dreamers are committed for treatment after failing to wake properly from the strange shared visions.
The investigators reconstruct Virgil's circumstances as faithfully as possible in hopes of reproducing the same crossing between the waking world and the Dreamlands.
Half the party prepares to cross into the Dreamlands directly, while the waking-world team will remain behind and begin its own linked campaign separately.

items: Each dreamlands investigator chose a different dream entry at setup: Silas Marsh took the Survivor dream, Mandy Thompson took the Miskatonic / Scholar dream, and Wilson Richards took the Guardian dream.
The scenario began without an encounter deck, creating an unusually quiet opening stretch before the mythos pressure arrived later.

Each Dream-Quest investigator earned 13 XP from the scenario.

metaItems: Session: Prologue (Web of Dreams) + Scenario I-B + Interlude I + Scenario II-B

notes.title: Background
items: Friday, February 13th, 1925. While the dreamers attempt to reproduce Virgil Gray's crossing, the waking-world investigators remain in Arkham to watch over them and respond if the experiment goes wrong.
Something does go wrong: the sleepers fail to wake naturally, their condition worsens, and the waking-world team is forced into its own linked investigation alongside the dream journey.

notes.title: Web Of Dreams Setup
items: The waking-world team begins by studying the dreamers' physical condition, guarding them, and trying to understand whether the shared visions have opened some path between worlds.
This parallel campaign follows the consequences in Arkham while the Dream-Quest investigators disappear into the Dreamlands.

notes.title: Hospital Crisis
items: More than twenty-four hours after the dreamers fell asleep, the waking-world team carried their unconscious companions to St. Mary's Hospital.
Doctor Shivani Maheswaran joined the investigation as the patients' condition worsened and strange spiders began emerging from the ward.

notes.title: The Investigators Achieved Resolution I.
items: The investigators reached Resolution I, followed by the waking-world aftermath that leads directly into the Resolution 5 story text.
All three waking-world investigators survived the scenario.
Record: Dr. Maheswaran is alive.
Record: your companions' condition has worsened.
Record: Randolph escaped the hospital with the investigators.
Because this is an interconnected run, Campaign A also records: the dreamers grow weaker.
Joe Diamond earned Randolph Carter: Chained to the Waking World.
Each Web of Dreams investigator earned 11 XP from the scenario.

customizableHover.text: During Scenario I-B, Kymani Jones played Refine and checked the first Signal Mirror box for free. ☑ ☐

notes.title: Dream-Quest Side
items: The dreamers traveled with Randolph Carter to Ulthar, met Virgil Gray, and were interrupted by the mysterious black cat.
For the interconnected campaign choice, the lead investigator chose: tell your companions that they are in danger, and that you are safe.
Record: the black cat warned the others.
Add 1 tablet token to Campaign A's chaos bag.

notes.title: Web of Dreams Side
items: Outside St. Mary's Hospital, the same black cat delivered the Dream-Quest message to the waking-world investigators.
The standalone Web of Dreams branch that would record the black cat is at your side was not used in this interconnected run.
Shared consequence applied: add 1 tablet token to the chaos bag as instructed.
Proceed to Scenario II-B: A Thousand Shapes of Horror.

storyNotes.title: Scenario II-B: A Thousand Shapes of Horror

notes.title: Descent Into The Dreamlands
items: The waking-world investigators forced their way physically into the Dreamlands with Randolph Carter and pursued the lost key that could open the Gate of Dreams.
The black cat challenged Randolph's failed sense of wonder, leading the party toward the abandoned house where he first lost the key.

notes.title: The Investigators Achieved Resolution I.
items: The investigators reached Resolution I.
All three investigators resigned alive.
Record: Randolph survived the descent.
Record: the investigators possess the Silver Key.
Zoey Samaras earned The Silver Key: Key to the Gate of Dreams.
Each investigator earned 6 XP from the scenario.
Ongoing effect: add 1 skull token to Campaign B's chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign.
Next chapter: Scenario II-A, The Search for Kadath.

storyNotes.title: Scenario II-A: The Search for Kadath

notes.title: Search Across The Dreamlands
items: The Dream-Quest investigators continued their search for Kadath by traveling across multiple distant regions of the Dreamlands.
During the investigation, they made their way through Oriab, Mnar, the Forbidden Lands, and the Timeless Realm.
Across those locations, the investigators uncovered a total of 4 Signs of the Gods out of the 10 available in the scenario.

notes.title: The Investigators Achieved Resolution I.
items: The investigators reached Resolution I.
All three investigators resigned alive.
Each investigator earned 8 XP from the scenario.
Record: Virgil was captured.
Record: Randolph eluded capture.

notes.title: Web of Dreams Side
items: Following Scenario II-B, the black cat met the waking-world investigators at the end of the stairway and once again offered to pass a message between the two campaign groups.
For this shared interlude, the lead investigator chose: tell your companions that you are safe.
Record: the black cat warned the others.
Because the black cat is at your side had been recorded for Campaign B, that note was crossed off there and recorded in Campaign A instead.
Replace 1 tablet token in each campaign's chaos bag with 1 elder thing token.

notes.title: Dream-Quest Side
items: Following Scenario II-A, Virgil's cat found the Dream-Quest investigators aboard their ship and confirmed that Virgil had been captured by the Corsairs.
Because at least one investigator was not captured, the dreamers received the cat's warning directly.
The cat passed along the waking-world team's message that they were safe and remained with the dreamers for a while longer.
Proceed to Scenario III-A: Dark Side of the Moon.

storyNotes.title: Scenario III-A: Dark Side of the Moon

notes.title: Voyage Toward The Moon
items: The Dream-Quest investigators sailed onward in pursuit of the Corsairs' captives, following Randolph Carter toward the route that leads across the edge of the world and on toward the Moon.
The search for Virgil and the others continued without any additional setup notes recorded for this campaign page.

crossNotes.title: Cross-Campaign Notes
items: Track any story effects that explicitly carry from one line into the other here.
Keep separate chaos bag updates inside each track unless a rule specifically says the other line changes.
Use the alternating order above when adding scenario records and upgrade entries.
Dream-Quest Scenario I-A already recorded that the dreamers strayed from the path and that the chaos bag reached three skull tokens by scenario end.
Interlude I is one shared event for this run: resolve the Dream-Quest side first, then the Web of Dreams side, and apply the combined results across both campaign logs.

notes.title: Prologue Summary
items: Date card shown in the campaign guide: Friday, February 13th, 1925.
A strange shared-dream phenomenon is spreading through Arkham after Virgil Gray published an account of an impossible dream journey in Tales from Nevermore.
Multiple readers reported experiencing the exact same dream, drawing the attention of both the Arkham Advertiser and local experts.
Virgil Gray and many others were committed for treatment, but the investigators remain unconvinced that the events can be explained away as ordinary delusion or shared hysteria.
The party decides to recreate Virgil's dream conditions and split responsibilities: one team will travel into the dreamlands while the other remains in the waking world to observe and protect them.
Dream-Quest prologue instruction: proceed to Scenario I-A, Beyond the Gates of Sleep.

notes.title: Scenario I-A Setup Notes
items: At scenario start, each investigator chose a different dream entry as instructed.
Silas Marsh chose the Survivor dream and was instructed to search his deck for a Survivor card and play it, paying its cost.
Mandy Thompson chose the Miskatonic / Scholar dream and was instructed to search her deck for a Tome card and play it, paying its cost.
Wilson Richards chose the Guardian dream and was instructed to search his deck for a Guardian card and play it, paying its cost.

Special setup rule: there was no encounter deck at the start of the scenario, and act 1a prevented drawing encounter cards during the mythos phase until the encounter deck was formed later in the scenario.

notes.title: Scenario I-A Result Summary
items: Scenario result: Resolution 1.
Campaign log record added during the scenario: the dreamers strayed from the path.
Chaos bag end-state recorded from the app: the bag contained three skull tokens by scenario end.
All three Dream-Quest investigators survived the scenario: Wilson Richards, Silas Marsh, and Mandy Thompson.
Resolution 1 record added: the cats collected their tribute from the Zoogs.
Wilson Richards took the optional story asset and earned Randolph Carter: Expert Dreamer.
Victory display total recorded from the run: 13, so each investigator earned 13 XP from the scenario.

notes.title: Interlude I: The Black Cat (Dream-Quest Side)
items: Following Scenario I-A, the dreamers traveled beyond the Enchanted Woods with Randolph Carter and reached Ulthar, where they finally met Virgil Gray at Einar's Place.
Randolph told Virgil about the marvelous city beyond unknown Kadath, and the black cat interrupted the conversation with a warning that the dreamers could not yet return to the waking world.
Because this run is an interconnected eight-part campaign, the lead investigator chose to tell the companions in the waking world that they were in danger and that the dreamers were safe.
Campaign log record added from Interlude I: the black cat warned the others.
Dream-Quest effect applied: add 1 tablet token to Campaign A's chaos bag.

scenarios.text: The Black Cat delivered the cross-campaign warning, Campaign A recorded that the black cat warned the others, a tablet token was added to the Dream-Quest chaos bag, and the dreamlands party moved on to The Search for Kadath.

notes.title: Prologue Summary
items: Date card shown in the campaign guide: Friday, February 13th, 1925.
A strange shared-dream phenomenon is spreading through Arkham after Virgil Gray published an account of an impossible dream journey in Tales from Nevermore.
Multiple readers reported experiencing the exact same dream, drawing the attention of both the Arkham Advertiser and local experts.
Virgil Gray and many others were committed for treatment, but the investigators remain unconvinced that the events can be explained away as ordinary delusion or shared hysteria.
The party decides to recreate Virgil's dream conditions and split responsibilities: one team will travel into the dreamlands while the other remains in the waking world to observe and protect them.
Web of Dreams prologue instruction: proceed to Scenario I-B, Waking Nightmare.

notes.title: Scenario I-B Setup Notes
items: More than twenty-four hours after the dreamlands team fell asleep, the waking-world investigators brought their unconscious companions to St. Mary's Hospital in Arkham.
Nurse Greenberg admitted the patients for examination under Doctor Shivani Maheswaran, but the investigators received no clear explanation for their companions' worsening condition.
While waiting in the emergency ward, the investigators discovered strange spiders emerging from the patients' beds and the hospital began to feel increasingly abandoned and unsafe.
At the key story choice, the investigators convinced Doctor Maheswaran to come with them while they investigated, and the campaign log recorded that Dr. Maheswaran joined the investigation.

notes.title: Scenario I-B Result Summary
items: Scenario result: Resolution 1, followed by the waking-world aftermath that led into Resolution 5 story text.
All three Web of Dreams investigators survived the scenario: Zoey Samaras, Joe Diamond, and Kymani Jones.
Campaign log records added: Dr. Maheswaran is alive; your companions' condition has worsened; Randolph escaped the hospital with the investigators.
Because the run is interconnected, Campaign A also records that the dreamers grow weaker.
Joe Diamond took the optional story asset and earned Randolph Carter: Chained to the Waking World.
Victory display total recorded from the run: 11, so each investigator earned 11 XP from Scenario I-B.
Cleanup instruction noted from the app: remove the infestation bag and all infestation tokens; they do not need to be kept or recorded.

notes.title: Interlude I: The Black Cat (Web of Dreams Side)
items: Following Scenario I-B, the investigators were confronted outside St. Mary's Hospital by the same black cat, who carried a message from the dreamers.
Because this is an interconnected campaign, the Dream-Quest side was resolved first and the selected message delivered here was: tell your companions that they are in danger, and that you are safe.
Campaign log record added on the waking-world side: the black cat warned the others.
The Web of Dreams standalone branch that would record the black cat is at your side was not used for this linked run.
Shared interlude consequence applied: add 1 tablet token to the chaos bag as instructed.
Proceed to Scenario II-B, A Thousand Shapes of Horror.

notes.title: Scenario II-B Result Summary
items: Scenario result: Resolution 1.
All three Web of Dreams investigators resigned alive at scenario end: Zoey Samaras, Joe Diamond, and Kymani Jones.
Campaign log records added: Randolph survived the descent; the investigators possess the Silver Key.
Zoey Samaras took the optional story asset and earned The Silver Key: Key to the Gate of Dreams.
Victory display total recorded from the run: 6, so each investigator earned 6 XP from Scenario II-B.
Ongoing campaign effect: your body now walks within the slumbering Dreamlands; add 1 skull token to Campaign B's chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign.
Next chapter unlocked: proceed to Scenario II-A, The Search for Kadath.

scenarios.text: After Waking Nightmare and the linked Black Cat interlude, the waking-world team entered A Thousand Shapes of Horror, resigned alive at Resolution 1, and carried The Silver Key forward into Campaign B.
